mapper.sql: FROM ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si LEFT JOIN sys_student_match m ON CAST(m.student_profile_num AS UNSIGNED) = si.student_profile_number
LEFT JOIN ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si ON si.student_profile_number = CAST(m.student_profile_num AS UNSIGNED)

select m.id, COALESCE( m.student_profile_num, si.student_profile_number ) as student_profile_num, m.student_user_id_wecom, m.student_name_wecom, COALESCE(m.match_status, '0') as match_status, COALESCE(m.sync_status, '0') as sync_status, m.error_msg, m.create_time, m.update_time, si.student_id, si.in_school, si.school_year, si.student_profile_number, si.adid, si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.dsej_student_id

select m.id, m.student_profile_num, m.student_user_id_wecom, m.student_name_wecom, m.match_status, m.sync_status, m.error_msg, m.create_time, m.update_time, si.student_id, si.in_school, si.school_year, si.student_profile_number, si.adid, si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.dsej_student_id from sys_student_match m
mapper.select:
si.student_profile_number IS NOT NULL
and ( si.id_name like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.idNameQuery}, '%') or m.student_name_wecom like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.idNameQuery}, '%') )
and si.class_section like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.classSectionQuery}, '%')
and (m.match_status IS NULL OR m.match_status = '0')
and m.match_status = #{studentMatchDTO.matchStatus}
and (m.sync_status IS NULL OR m.sync_status = '0')
and m.sync_status = #{studentMatchDTO.syncStatus}
order by si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.student_profile_number
select id from sys_student_match where CAST(student_profile_num AS UNSIGNED) = CAST(#{sysStudentMatchProfileNumDTO.studentProfileNum} AS UNSIGNED) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_student_match (student_profile_num, match_status, sync_status, create_time) values (#{studentMatchInsertDTO.studentProfileNum}, '0', '0', sysdate())
mapper.select:
where si.student_profile_number IS NOT NULL and (m.match_status IS NULL OR m.match_status = '0')
and ( si.id_name like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.idNameQuery}, '%') or m.student_name_wecom like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.idNameQuery}, '%') )
and si.class_section like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.classSectionQuery}, '%')
order by si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.student_profile_number

SELECT DISTINCT r.student_user_id AS student_user_id, r.student_name AS student_name, r.mobile AS mobile, r.relation_desc AS relation_desc, cs.class_section_sp AS class_code_wecom FROM sys_parent_student_relation r LEFT JOIN sys_department_parent_binding b ON r.student_user_id = b.student_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON b.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN class_section cs ON d.name = cs.class_section_dsedj WHERE r.student_user_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT student_user_id_wecom FROM sys_student_match WHERE student_user_id_wecom IS NOT NULL )
AND ( r.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{wecomStudentDTO.queryNameTraditional}, '%') OR r.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{wecomStudentDTO.queryNameSimplified}, '%') )
AND r.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{wecomStudentDTO.queryMobile}, '%')
AND cs.class_section_sp LIKE CONCAT('%', #{wecomStudentDTO.queryClass}, '%')
ORDER BY r.student_name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT r.student_user_id AS student_user_id, r.student_name AS student_name, cs.class_section_sp AS class_code_wecom FROM sys_parent_student_relation r INNER JOIN sys_department_parent_binding b ON r.student_user_id = b.student_user_id INNER JOIN sys_department d ON b.department_id = d.id INNER JOIN class_section cs ON d.name = cs.class_section_dsedj
